answer:
Verdict: yes

The `ticker` process (PID 628703) started at 2026-11-21 01:06:13.111 UTC. Its `sampler` thread (TID 628705, CPU 3) began spending longer on each run at about 01:06:25.13 UTC—roughly 12 seconds after launch. Its median time between being scheduled in and out was about 212 μs early in the run, rising to 252.6 μs in the 15–20-second window and staying higher afterward.

The sampler’s wakeup cadence stayed near 2 ms throughout. So the trace shows its per-run work getting slower, but does not show the ticker’s output cadence slowing.
